arStrings.szText: {c_important}Rally's{/c} increases your Movement Speed by an additional {c_number}[{SF_15} * 100|%+|]{/c} and generates {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} additional Faith.
{c_important}Rally{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} more Faith and gains {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} additional Charge.

{c_important}Rally{/c} now costs {c_number}[{SF_7} * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_7})]){/c} and can stack up to {c_number}[{SF_11}]{/c} times.
Casting {c_important}Rally{/c} increases your Critical Strike Chance by {c_number}[{SF_17} * 100|%+|]{/c} while active.
{c_important}Rally's{/c} Cooldown and Costs are reduced by {c_number}[{SF_14} * 100|%|]{/c}.
Casting {c_important}Rally's{/c} increases your Movement Speed by an additional {c_number}[{SF_15} * 100|%+|]{/c} and grants {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} while active.
